title: CISA Warns of 4 Exploited Flaws Linked to Ransomware, Cryptomining, and LLMjacking Attacks
content_md: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added four vulnerabilities impacting Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM), BerriAI LiteLLM, Apache Axis, and Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. The vulnerabilities are listed below -

CVE-2026-90436.evidence: CISA KEV addition citing active exploitation; Rapid7 observed attacks on Atlassian Confluence via the Axis library.

CVE-2026-90817.evidence: CISA KEV addition citing active exploitation; Safe Security observed web-shell staging and XMRig deployment.

CVE-2026-40217.evidence: CISA KEV addition; Google Threat Intelligence reported LLMjacking campaigns abusing LiteLLM inference keys for admin access.

CVE-2024-10441.evidence: CISA KEV addition; Synology disclosed exploitation in ransomware attacks deploying C3RB3R on NAS devices.
